description: Window and geography coverage is partial: twelve Italian-language web queries covered broad early/mid/late-February searches plus targeted Cospito, labour, school and port-worker leads. Search output was not a systematic all-region archive; no Lexis-Nexis/newspaper archive access, and no exhaustive province-by-province search. Search failure/no lead is not evidence of absence.
required_followup: Continue date-delimited searches by region and non-Cospito sectors; prioritize source-rich local press and distinguish month-of-event from publication date.

description: E015 Genova Feb 25: event and >2,000 local participants are supported by one opened local story, but direct demand on Italian government/port or arms policy is not explicit; exact end and any coded state response are unknown. The organizer preview reports 10,000, which differs from media estimates and is not independently verified.
required_followup: Find permitted full local reporting or organizer platform language that directly identifies the state policy target; verify ending/dissolution and any distinct response.

description: E002 Milan Feb 3 Cospito march: about 200 local participants and public occurrence appear only in a TGR Lombardia preview.
required_followup: Locate a permitted full contemporaneous Milan report and verify count, venue/route and policy demand.

description: E003 Milan Feb 4 Opera prison gathering: la Repubblica preview reports over 200, but occurrence/public access and local attendance have not been body-verified; keep separate from Feb 3 central Milan.
required_followup: Find permitted full local coverage to verify that the Opera gathering occurred and its single-site count.

description: E004 Rome Feb 4 march: search snippets conflict between about 200 and about 800 for the Piazza Vittorio–Prenestino march; no article body read.
required_followup: Compare exact local articles and identify which estimate refers to the local march; preserve source attribution and route.

description: E005 Cagliari Feb 4: approximately 100 local participants is snippet-only; the reported event is not body-verified.
required_followup: Find a permitted local Cagliari report and verify simultaneous attendance.

description: E006 Bologna Feb 4 Pratello gathering: a rehosted la Repubblica preview says 50; exact local attendance/simultaneity and source scope remain unresolved.
required_followup: Verify through original or permitted local source; do not round exactly 50 upward.

description: E007 Naples Feb 7 unemployed march: actual march is reported by ANSA, but crowd size, route and explicit government/policy target are unknown.
required_followup: Find local post-event reporting with a local attendance estimate and any explicit public policy demand.

description: E008 Bologna Feb 8 march against 12 precautionary measures: preview reports 500, but exact body open failed technically without HTTP status/body; precise state actor/demand scope is unresolved.
required_followup: Use another permitted source if available; no retry or URL variant of the failed Corriere URL.

description: E009 Rome Feb 10 school-sector demonstration: USB announced a public event and ANSA reported school-sector strike initiatives, but execution at the ministry and local attendance were not confirmed.
required_followup: Find a post-event local report proving execution, venue and crowd; announcement/strike participation cannot substitute for an assembled crowd.

description: E010 Milan Feb 11 Cospito march: multiple snippets report around 200; Corriere exact open returned a tool-level Internal Error without HTTP status/body, and ANSA body was not opened.
required_followup: Find permitted full local reporting; do not retry the exact Corriere URL.

description: E011 Torino Feb 12 Cospito-related actions: preview names several distinct sites/activities but gives no attendance per simultaneous crowd; do not combine site counts or infer a citywide total.
required_followup: Review full Torino reporting for specific site-level attendance, publicness and continuity.

description: E012 Genoa Feb 22 Ansaldo worker-safety march: occurrence/date/location appear in a local preview, but attendance and any demand to Italian state policy are not established.
required_followup: Find permitted post-event local coverage documenting crowd and whether a concrete public-policy demand was made.

description: E013 Rome Feb 24 Cassation sit-in: a video preview identifies the local place, date and anti-41-bis banners but no crowd size.
required_followup: Seek local reporting with an actual, simultaneous Piazza Cavour attendance estimate.

description: E014 Milan Feb 25 Cobas march: Corriere title reports 500 and ANSA preview mentions cost of living; both remain search-only, so turnout and government-directed demand need verification.
required_followup: Find permitted full local coverage and specify the concrete policy demand.

description: The captured queries return considerable irrelevant, stale and future-date material; no complete screening of all 618-ish headers is a substitute for date-anchored regional coverage. No reliable basis for a zero-event finding or for an exhaustive candidate inventory.
required_followup: After the captured candidate assessment, perform remaining region/sector/date query windows and retain exact raw outputs before parsing.
